description: extract.json: the generated reduction of Qualys's output DTDs to the elements this plugin reads.

description.description: What this file is and that it is generated.

documents.description: One entry per Qualys output document.

source.description: The committed DTD the entry was reduced from.

elements.description: Each element the plugin reads, keyed by name.

content.description: The DTD's content model, whitespace removed; null when the DTD names but does not declare the element.

single_children.description: Children the content model allows at most once.

attributes.description: The element's ATTLIST entries, by attribute name.

declared.description: Whether the DTD declares the element.

note.description: Why an undeclared element is read anyway.
